observations: glibc defines a five-second default resolver timeout.
The resolver uses its configured retransmission timeout while waiting for datagram responses.
local_confirmation: A real ordinary-UID dual-stack lookup against a serialized 800ms-per-answer DNS server fails with timeout:1 attempts:1 and succeeds with timeout:5 attempts:1; full protected native credential acceptance is separate.

observations: The successful upstream response is passed through the DNS notification callback before the response is written to the endpoint.
A callback error returns an error response rather than publishing the upstream answer.
Proxy timing and upstream response success are recorded separately.
cilium_comparison.applicability: Compare phase order and diagnosis only. Cilium datapath, timeout and authority assumptions do not replace GoldenHoop native readback, finite leases or scoped source grants.
cilium_comparison.local_status: Both native runtimes confirm successful DNS installation; actual libc latency experiment confirms the one-second client timeout incompatibility.
